name: Close-Grip Push-Up with Hand Deficit
description: A close-grip push-up with hands on elevated platforms, allowing the chest to descend below hand level for greater range of motion. The deficit increases the stretch on the triceps and chest at the bottom position, increasing overall training effect.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Close-Grip Push-Up with Hand Deficit in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Close-Grip Push-Up with Hand Deficit.
steps: Step 1: Place hands close together on two equal platforms. Extend body to push-up position.
Step 2: Lower chest below hands taking advantage of full depth.
Step 3: Hold briefly at bottom to eliminate elastic rebound.
Step 4: Press back to full extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Hands too close causing wrist pain
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Get full depth at the bottom
